head.text: WF-039: host remote wake of a suspended port (OP-009, success; DEC-049 Q2)

foot.text: Not to scale. The suspended device drives K for 1 to 15 ms (remote wakeup). With CLK-PHY stopped, m_usb2_utmilp sees the line leave J for 4 CLK-BUS cycles and raises SuspendM; with CLK-PHY running this step is not needed. Once CLK-PHY runs, the speed engine filters the K for 2.5 us and goes from HP_SUSP to HP_RESM: the host drives resume K (OpMode 10b) for 20 ms, ends it with a low-speed EOP (full- or low-speed port) or high-speed idle, returns to HP_EN, raises irq_raw.resume and sends SOF within 3 ms (REQ-FUNC-020). An SE0 longer than 2.5 us in HP_SUSP is a disconnect (HP_OFF, irq_raw.disc).
